ns2:section.sectionText: Prepares students for careers in agricultural communications through discussion of current national and international trends in the field, practice handling ethical and controversial issues and crisis communication, and the developemt of materials to obtain and start a job or graduate school successfully. Course is designed for students near graduation. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.illinois.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
